name: lazada-shopping
title_zh: Lazada 购物车管家：比价常购清单、补鲜货
tagline_zh: 对着RedMart购物车发愁时，它翻出你上次买的同款，提醒哪些该补货、哪些换新品。不用再翻历史订单凭记忆凑单。
tagline_en: Stuck on RedMart? It digs up your last order, flags what to restock, and swaps in fresh picks—no more guessing.
desc_en: Shop Lazada/RedMart groceries, compare a shopping list with previous purchases, suggest fresh options, and manage the user's cart through the Lazada MCP. Use for RedMart grocery lists, usual purchases, and shopping preferences.
why_zh: 不是简单列清单，而是拿历史购买记录当参照系：同品比价、缺货提醒、按偏好推替代。
why_en: It doesn't just list items—it uses your purchase history as a baseline: price compare, flag missing staples, suggest swaps by.
limit_zh: 只认Lazada/RedMart的购物车和订单数据，不接其他平台；需要已登录的MCP会话；它只负责选品和加购。
limit_en: Only works with Lazada/RedMart carts & order history via an authenticated MCP session; it curates and adds items—no payment, delivery, or coupon.
title_en: Lazada cart manager: compare usual buys, suggest fresh.
